trends.details: Sequin party season rolls on, with velvet as its softer twin — and one voice pushing back. A 2.9K-like reel walks a black sequined mini-dress with a plunging V-neck and high side slit under a long black coat through golden-hour smoke, shot like a perfume ad. A 2.5K-like carousel answers 'What to wear for the party season' with six looks: a dark velvet wrap blazer with wide-leg jeans, a bronze velvet wrap dress, a leopard coat over a bright red ruched top, a burgundy puff-sleeve dress with knee-high boots, a navy cap-sleeve top with white lace trim, and a silver sequin fit-and-flare mini. A 1.9K-like 20-slide carousel runs through holiday outfit ideas — a long black sequined gown, a sheer black lace top, a strapless burgundy velvet mini, a red turtleneck with sequin shorts, a black velvet jumpsuit, a red satin fringe mini and an emerald velvet wrap jumpsuit — plus a glitter stick for legs 'like Barbie'. A 1.1K-like reel from a New York hotel room tries on plus-size party picks: a red sequin mini, burgundy sequin wide-leg pants, a navy velvet fit-and-flare dress and a silver sequin asymmetric midi skirt. The counterpoint comes in a 49-like guide advising viewers to 'put down the sequins' for a black velvet blazer with feather-trim cuffs, wide-leg trousers and patent heels. A 42-like 'Styling Sequins' guide mixes black sequin separates over a white shirt, a silver sequin midi skirt, and burgundy sequin wide-leg trousers with a fuzzy grey sweater.
trends.title: Sequin party season rolls on — black sequin minis, velvet wraps, and a 'put down the sequins' backlash

trends.details: Dark by 5pm, lights up: cozy Christmas home tours take over. A 15K-like evening tour opens on the line 'It's dark by 5:00pm because you're supposed to have your Christmas lights up' — a lit tree with red bows and plaid ornaments, a mantel of village houses and candles, stockings, and two children in pajamas watching a snowy movie under blankets. A 13K-like cinematic walkthrough tours an opulent home in whites, blacks and golds, with fresh garlands strung with warm fairy lights and several trees in cream ribbons and gold and silver ornaments. A 2.6K-like flocked-tree setup dresses the tree in red, green and gold ornaments and plaid baubles with personalized family ornaments, declaring the creator is 'tired of the beige aesthetic' and leaning into 1990s Christmas nostalgia. A 1.8K-like Virginia home carousel layers greenery and dried orange slices, copper pans, a tabletop tree and a nutcracker vignette — 'creating the backdrop to our memories'. A 1.2K-like snap-transition montage reveals a different decorated tree in every room: a pink tree in the bedroom, red-and-gold on the landing, burgundy in the dining room, a flocked green-and-gold tree, and a navy-blue, gold and white tree in the foyer. A 500-like tour leans opulent — red velvet throws, gold reindeer, a crystal chandelier. A 340-like guide builds a Hallmark-style cozy home with red chandelier shades, chunky knit throws, wreaths with long red ribbons and poinsettias.
trends.title: Dark by 5pm, lights up — cozy Christmas tours, flocked trees, and a break from beige

trends.details: Glitter goes everywhere this holiday season. A 15K-like reel markets a 'HOLIDAY GLOW-UP ESSENTIAL GLINT GLITTER' — an iridescent glitter gel dabbed under the eyes, worn with leopard-print nails, a red lip and winged liner. A 2.3K-like Marc Jacobs holiday glam tutorial builds an icy smoky eye with star-shaped palettes, 'Joystick Blush' and a red 'Love Muscle' lipstick. A 1.2K-like vlog paints a whole gingerbread house on one cheek — white icing lines, red and green details — ahead of a gingerbread-making party. A 700-like 'Peppermint Sugar Eyes' tutorial blends bright pink into the crease, presses silver glitter onto the lid, adds a sharp wing and finishes with a berry-red matte lip. A 550-like look offers frosty lilac eyeshadow as the alternative to metallics: a lavender stick layered with purple glitter, silver inner corners and black mascara. A 310-like soft winter look pairs a lavender-purple shadow with rosy cheeks and glossy lips. A 220-like Hourglass demo shows the Scattered Light Glitter Eyeshadow in 'Ray' blended onto the lid for a holiday eye.
trends.title: Glitter goes everywhere — frosty lilac eyes, peppermint pink, and gingerbread face paint
